component.name: tahu-edge
component.title: Tahu Edge Node / Device
component.description: Publish the Sparkplug B messages of Edge Nodes and Devices to MQTT servers using Eclipse Tahu.
component.label: messaging,iot,monitoring

checkClientIdLength.label: common
checkClientIdLength.description: Whether to fail when an MQTT client ID is longer than 23 characters, the limit of MQTT 3.1.1. A generated client ID is always shorter.

clientId.label: common
clientId.description: The MQTT client ID for each server whose definition in the servers option has no client ID. If neither is set, a random client ID that starts with Camel is generated for the server.

keepAliveTimeout.label: common
keepAliveTimeout.description: MQTT connection keep alive timeout, in seconds

rebirthDebounceDelay.label: common
rebirthDebounceDelay.description: The time in milliseconds after a birth or rebirth during which the Edge Node ignores further rebirth requests. Only an Edge Node endpoint of tahu-edge uses it, tahu-host does not.

servers.label: common
servers.description: The MQTT servers, as a comma-separated list of definitions with the syntax name:[clientId:](tcp|ssl)://host[:port], for example Mqtt:tcp://localhost:1883. The clientId of a definition replaces the clientId option for that server. A tahu-edge Device endpoint does not use it, as its Edge Node endpoint connects to the servers.

lazyStartProducer.label: producer
lazyStartProducer.description: Whether the producer should be started lazy (on the first message). By starting lazy you can use this to allow CamelContext and routes to startup in situations where a producer may otherwise fail during starting and cause the route to fail being started. By deferring this startup to be lazy then the startup failure can be handled during routing messages via Camel's routing error handlers. Beware that when the first message is processed then creating and starting the producer may take a little time and prolong the total processing time of the processing.

autowiredEnabled.label: advanced
autowiredEnabled.description: Whether autowiring is enabled. This is used for automatic autowiring options (the option must be marked as autowired) by looking up in the registry to find if there is a single instance of matching type, which then gets configured on the component. This can be used for automatic configuring JDBC data sources, JMS connection factories, AWS Clients, etc.

configuration.label: advanced
configuration.description: The shared configuration of the endpoints. Each endpoint gets a copy of it, which the options of the endpoint then change.

sslContextParameters.label: security
sslContextParameters.description: Not supported: Eclipse Tahu creates its MQTT clients without these TLS settings, so the endpoint fails to start when this option is set. An ssl:// server is checked with the default trust store of the JVM, which the javax.net.ssl.* system properties configure.

useGlobalSslContextParameters.label: security
useGlobalSslContextParameters.description: Not supported: when true and a global SSLContextParameters is configured, the endpoints fail to start, as Eclipse Tahu creates its MQTT clients without these TLS settings. An ssl:// server is checked with the default trust store of the JVM, which the javax.net.ssl.* system properties configure.

CamelTahuMessageType.description: The Sparkplug message type. The consumer sets it on the exchange of each message, but not on the exchange of a single metric. The producer sets it to NDATA for an Edge Node and to DDATA for a Device.

CamelTahuEdgeNodeDescriptor.description: The Edge Node or Device of the message or metric, as groupId/edgeNode or groupId/edgeNode/deviceId. The consumer sets it as a String, and the producer sets the Tahu EdgeNodeDescriptor of the endpoint, a DeviceDescriptor for a Device.

CamelTahuMessageTimestamp.description: The timestamp of the Sparkplug payload. The consumer sets it in milliseconds since the epoch, and the producer sets the java.util.Date of the payload it publishes.

CamelTahuMessageUUID.description: The UUID of the Sparkplug payload. The consumer sets it when the payload has a valid UUID. The producer uses it as the UUID of a payload that it makes from the message, and sets it to the UUID of the payload it publishes, as a String.

CamelTahuMessageSequenceNumber.description: The sequence number of the Sparkplug payload. The consumer sets it when the payload has one, and the producer only when the payload to publish already has one.

producerIn.description: A Tahu SparkplugBPayload with the metrics to publish. For any other body the metrics are made from the CamelTahuMetric.<name> headers, and the body, converted to bytes, is the body of the payload (no body gives a payload without body). A body that does not convert to bytes fails

groupId.label: producer
groupId.description: The Sparkplug group ID of the Edge Node.

edgeNode.label: producer
edgeNode.description: The Sparkplug Edge Node ID. With the groupId, it identifies the Edge Node.

deviceId.label: producer
deviceId.description: The Sparkplug device ID of a Device of the Edge Node. With it, the endpoint is a Device endpoint; without it, an Edge Node endpoint.

checkClientIdLength.description: Whether to fail when an MQTT client ID is longer than 23 characters, the limit of MQTT 3.1.1. A generated client ID is always shorter.

clientId.description: The MQTT client ID for each server whose definition in the servers option has no client ID. If neither is set, a random client ID that starts with Camel is generated for the server.

keepAliveTimeout.description: MQTT connection keep alive timeout, in seconds

The clientId of a definition replaces the clientId option for that server. A tahu-edge Device endpoint does not use it, as its Edge Node endpoint connects to the servers.

deviceIds.label: producer
deviceIds.description: The device IDs of the Devices of the Edge Node, as a comma-separated list. Used by an Edge Node endpoint only.

metricDataTypePayloadMap.label: producer
metricDataTypePayloadMap.description: The Tahu SparkplugBPayloadMap with every metric of the Edge Node or Device: its name, data type and initial value. The NBIRTH or DBIRTH message has these metrics, and the producer updates their values with each payload it publishes, so a later birth message has the last values.

primaryHostId.label: producer
primaryHostId.description: The host ID of the primary Host Application of the Edge Node. If set, the Edge Node waits for the STATE message that says this Host Application is online before it publishes its birth messages, and disconnects from a server when it goes offline. Used by an Edge Node endpoint only.

bdSeqManager.label: producer,advanced
bdSeqManager.description: The org.eclipse.tahu.message.BdSeqManager that keeps the birth-death sequence number (bdSeq) of the Edge Node from one MQTT session to the next. If not set, a CamelBdSeqManager keeps it in a file below the bdSeqNumPath directory. Used by an Edge Node endpoint only.

bdSeqNumPath.label: producer,advanced
bdSeqNumPath.description: The directory in which the default bdSeqManager keeps the next birth-death sequence number of the Edge Node, in the file groupId/edgeNode-bdSeqNum below it, named after the IDs of the Edge Node. The process must be able to write to it. Not used when the bdSeqManager option is set.

headerFilterStrategy.label: producer,advanced
headerFilterStrategy.description: To use a custom HeaderFilterStrategy to filter headers used as Sparkplug metrics. Default value notice: Defaults to sending all Camel Message headers with name prefixes of CamelTahuMetric., including those with null values

useAliases.label: producer,advanced
useAliases.description: Whether to use metric aliases: Tahu gives each metric a generated alias in the birth messages, and the data messages carry the alias instead of the name. Used by an Edge Node endpoint only.
